sponsoring_body: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_amount: Composite bank loan between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for Greenfield Enterprises
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or the trading sector. In case of non-individual enterprises, at least 51% of shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Caste Certificate|Detailed Project Report (DPR)|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)|Land / Rent Agreement of Workplace

sponsoring_body: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), MoSJE
benefit_amount: Concessional credit up to ₹50 Lakhs (up to 95% of project cost) @ 6% to 9% p.a.
description: Provides term loans to Scheduled Caste individuals living below double the poverty line or with family income up to ₹3.00 Lakhs p.a. for viable income-generating projects in manufacturing, service sector, small transport, agriculture, and artisan trades. Repayment duration extends up to 10 years with generous moratorium periods.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Caste Certificate|Income Certificate|Detailed Project Report (DPR)|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)

sponsoring_body: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC), Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefit_amount: Concessional micro-credit up to ₹2 Lakhs per beneficiary @ 4% per annum interest
description: Exclusive concessional credit scheme for Scheduled Tribe (ST) women entrepreneurs. Provides loan assistance up to 90% of unit costs up to ₹2 Lakhs for taking up sustainable income-generating ventures like organic farming, handlooms, food processing, eco-tourism, retail shops, and tribal handicraft units.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|Caste Certificate|Income Certificate|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)

sponsoring_body: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefit_amount: ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive + Collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 Lakhs (Tranche 1: ₹1L, Tranche 2: ₹2L) @ 5% interest
description: Holistic end-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 traditional family trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers, weavers, tailors, sculptors, etc.). Includes PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, basic & advanced skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant, concessional collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3,00,000, digital transaction cashback, and marketing linkage on GeM.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)|Skill Training / Artisan Certificate|Business Registration (Udyam)

scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
sponsoring_body: IFCI Venture / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefit_amount: Equity and quasi-equity investment from ₹20 Lakhs up to ₹15 Crores per SC-promoted venture
description: Promotes entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs by providing long-term equity, quasi-equity, and debenture financing to innovative technology startups and scaling industrial projects. The enterprise must be at least 51% owned and controlled by SC entrepreneurs for at least 6 months with management control.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Caste Certificate|Detailed Project Report (DPR)|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)|Business Registration (Udyam)

sponsoring_body: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC), MoSJE
benefit_amount: Term loan up to ₹15 Lakhs (up to 85% of project cost) @ 6% to 8% interest p.a.
description: Provides concessional financial assistance to Other Backward Classes (OBC) and De-Notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT) living below the annual family income limit of ₹3.00 Lakhs. Covers setup of retail shops, service centers, dairy units, transport vehicles, apparel manufacturing, and light engineering.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Caste Certificate|Income Certificate|Detailed Project Report (DPR)|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)

sponsoring_body: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC), DEPwD, MoSJE
benefit_amount: Concessional credit up to ₹25 Lakhs @ 5% to 8% interest p.a. (1% rebate for women with disabilities)
description: Provides soft loans to Persons with Disabilities (PwD / Divyangjan with 40% or more certified disability) for starting micro-enterprises, commercial vehicles, IT service hubs, small manufacturing units, and assistive tech retail. Offers flexible repayment up to 10 years and special interest rebate for prompt repayment.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|UDID / Disability Certificate|Detailed Project Report (DPR)|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)

sponsoring_body: KVIC / Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefit_amount: Credit-linked capital subsidy up to 35% on manufacturing projects up to ₹50 Lakhs and service units up to ₹20 Lakhs
description: Flagship credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment ventures. Special category beneficiaries (SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, Women, Ex-Servicemen, PwD, North Eastern Region, Hill and Border areas) receive 35% margin money subsidy in rural areas and 25% in urban areas with beneficiary own-contribution of only 5%.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Caste Certificate|Detailed Project Report (DPR)|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)|Skill Training / Artisan Certificate

sponsoring_body: MUDRA / Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_amount: Collateral-free micro-finance loans in 3 tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs, enhanced to ₹20 Lakhs)
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across manufacturing, trade, services, retail shops, food processing, and allied agricultural activities. Easy processing through public, private, and regional rural banks with no margin money requirement for Shishu loans.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)|Business Registration (Udyam)

sponsoring_body: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), MoSJE
benefit_amount: Micro-credit up to ₹1,40,000 per woman beneficiary @ 4% per annum interest
description: Targeted micro-credit scheme for Scheduled Caste women living below double poverty line or annual household income under ₹3.00 Lakhs. Channelled through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks, and Nationalised Banks to promote self-help groups, tailoring, dairy farming, weaving, and petty shops.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|Caste Certificate|Income Certificate|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)

scheme_name: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC) Term Loan
sponsoring_body: NSKFDC, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
benefit_amount: Concessional loans up to ₹15 Lakhs (sanitation projects up to ₹50 Lakhs) @ 4% to 6% p.a.
description: Empowers Safai Karamcharis, Manual Scavengers, and their direct dependents for socioeconomic rehabilitation through alternative self-employment ventures, mechanised sanitation equipment, commercial driving, and retail trades. No income limit for target group.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|PAN Card|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)|Detailed Project Report (DPR)

sponsoring_body: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefit_amount: Credit up to ₹10 Lakhs for craftspersons @ 5% interest (4% for craftswomen)
description: Targeted credit support to artisans and craftspeople belonging to notified Minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) for preserving traditional crafts, working capital, purchasing raw materials, and modern hand tools.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card|Caste Certificate|Income Certificate|Skill Training / Artisan Certificate|Bank Account Statement (6 Months)
